description: Crop the image to a rectangle (Image > Crop, or the Crop tool), optionally rotating the crop and resampling the result to a size. Bounds reaching outside the canvas extend it, as dragging the Crop tool past the edge does

bounds.description: A rectangle in pixels from the document's top-left corner

height.description: Resample the result to this height in pixels

width.description: Resample the result to this width in pixels

name: crop_image
title: Crop Image
